subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic observation-only reaction hook names and payloads to the public plugin API now, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or cross-channel?
rationale: Source inspection proves the missing delivery path, but the permanent public hook name, payload, enrichment, and cross-channel scope are API/product choices that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve generic observation hooks
options.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as observation-only public hooks with a shared payload shape, then wire Discord first with tests and docs while preserving cross-channel parity.

options.title: Scope Discord first
options.body: Accept a Discord-first contract now, with explicit follow-up requirements so other channel reaction payloads do not drift permanently.

options.title: Defer public API
options.body: Keep reaction automation on system events or external workarounds until maintainers are ready to sponsor a broader plugin-hook design.

recommendation.title: Approve generic observation hooks
recommendation.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as observation-only public hooks with a shared payload shape, then wire Discord first with tests and docs while preserving cross-channel parity.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest available routing candidate because recent history ties him to the plugin hook contract files this public API decision would change.
